```{r}
# install.packages(c("dplyr", "nycflights13"))   # run once
library(dplyr)
library(nycflights13)
dim(flights)          # 336776 rows, 19 columns
```

## 1. select(): choose columns

```{r}
select(flights, year, month, day, carrier, dep_delay)
```

## 2. filter(): choose rows

```{r}
filter(flights, month == 1, day == 1)    # flights on 1 January: 842
filter(flights, dest == "ATL")           # flights to Atlanta: 17215
```

## 3. arrange(): sort

```{r}
arrange(flights, desc(dep_delay))        # most delayed first: 1301 minutes!
```

## 4. rename(): change a column name

```{r}
rename(flights, airline = carrier)
```

## 5. mutate(): create a new column

```{r}
mutate(flights, speed = distance / air_time * 60)   # speed in miles per hour
```
```{r}

## 6. group_by

d <- data.frame(name  = c("Ana", "Ben", "Sam", "Eva", "Tom", "Joy"),
                class = c("A", "A", "A", "B", "B", "B"),
                score = c(70, 80, 85, 60, 90, 75))

piles <- group_by(d, class)          # make piles by class
summarize(piles, avg = mean(score))  # average of each pile
```
```{r}
d %>% group_by(class) %>% summarize(avg = mean(score)) #take d, then make piles by class, then average each pile
```
